The bounded native video metadata helper uses Windows SDK projections 10.0.19041.57 and C#/WinRT runtime 2.2.0.

License sources: https://aka.ms/WinSDKLicenseURL and https://github.com/microsoft/CsWinRT/blob/master/LICENSE . The helper is published as NativeAOT; it does not require an installed .NET runtime. Windows supplies the actual media codecs.
